svg.title: Rocklea R12: the iron-oxide index and the geochemical review
svg.desc: Index calibration RMSE 11.99 wt% Fe against OK 13.85 on 701 test rows. Recall by alteration (autoencoder, PCA): one property x 10 0.77, 0.77; percent read as ppm 1.00, 1.00; Fe and SiO2 from another hole 0.38, 0.20; shift 0.25 0.07, 0.08; shift 1 0.28, 0.15; shift 3 0.93, 0.98; false flags 0.06, 0.07.
svg.text: Rocklea R12: what the iron-oxide index predicts, and what the autoencoder review notices
Left: test rows of confirmed holes, and the monotone fit on the training holes; RMSE 11.99 wt% Fe against OK 13.85 on the same 701 rows.
Right: the share of each constructed alteration flagged at the review threshold, and of the unchanged records.
